## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      4 avis récents mentionnent prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 6 août 2026 - 27 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _77Corinne_, 27 sept. 2026, 3/5: "Lately every few days it gives me an error and says I have to restart. I have a paid membership and every time this happens I lose my progress in islands, materials, etc because I have to use a back up file. It is frustrating that this should not be happening when I pay the subscription price. It’s frustrating to lose all of the progress that I have been obtaining for over a year."
            2. _ohmanitsjesi_, 26 sept. 2026, 3/5: "I used to LOVE this app. The vibes were immaculate. Then about three months ago they started doing Disney collaborations and for me it just ruined the whole thing. The themes used to be cute and creative and now it feels like an advert rather than something that adds to my life. I cancelled my premium subscription. I hope they change this."
            3. _mysticalgamer666_, 6 août 2026, 4/5: "Makes cleaning and self care fun. The only problems i have with it is that, majority of items are either too expensive, or locked behind Finch Plus. For people like me who can’t afford £50 a year, it makes it somewhat inaccessible."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Pression publicitaire** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Pression publicitaire.**
      1 avis récent mentionne pression publicitaire.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 10 sept. 2026 - 10 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs remarquent la pression publicitaire. Cela signale une friction de monétisation et une ouverture pour un concurrent plus propre.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _spudd122_, 10 sept. 2026, 4/5: "I’ve really loved this app for over 2 years now. It’s been helpful for building good habits and staying on top of self-care and mental health. However, the month long events turning into a month long advertisement for an upcoming movie every few months is getting annoying and old quick. I understand this app is free, but forcing month long ads on your customers shouldn’t be the way to pay for it. Ads annoy people and they’ll stop using your product to avoid them."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      2 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 28 mai 2026 - 25 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _plantguyhome_, 28 mai 2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
            2. _rmandy22_, 25 sept. 2026, 5/5: "This is my number one app, come as another one like this one. However. isn’t that one not that great. I love this one. With the new iOS 27, seems to be broken, the daily goals. I can’t do accept some other daily goals. Not even the goals that you do with certain topics. Also to email you guys, the support area of emails to report bugs. Is no longer available. At least I do not see with VoiceOver. I have started having this problem soon as I updated to iOS 27."
            3. _epicinsomniac_, 13 août 2026, 5/5: "I’ve just moved into my own place and I have a whole lot of mental issues that tend to get in the way of me hardly looking after myself. I downloaded this when I moved into my own place a few days ago and so far, I’m checking it every day, knocking off goals and getting to actually do more things for myself than I ever have before while also playing with my pet on here. I already love it even though I was truly sceptical at first."
<!--/ir-theme-->
